note: Inyo NF campground on the June Lake Loop (Hwy 158), on the east side of the highway at the north end of 97-acre Silver Lake, with Rush Creek along its east edge; Silver Lake Resort's store and cafe, the pack station and an Ansel Adams Wilderness trailhead are across the road. Mix of open and willow/aspen-shaded sites; boat launch nearby. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS page read: $32 confirmed (+$10 extra vehicle), rec.gov reservable 14 nights, no hookups confirmed, 63 sites / 38 ft kept (FS says 40), flush + water, season 04-17..10-24; lakefront -> lakeview recommended (loop road + willow belt between the lakeside sites and the shore); pin ~300 m off across the highway; phone, FS link and policy_ref flags.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'lakefront' -> recommend 'lakeview'. The lakeside sites are 018-025 (018 37.78107,-119.12680; 019 37.78132,-119.12674; 023 37.78181,-119.12642; 024 37.78192,-119.12614; 025 37.78234,-119.12570), 20-30 m from the shore, but on Esri (hw 110 m) the campground's own loop road runs along the shore in front of them and a continuous willow belt lines the water - a loop road between the sites and the water is lakeview at best (AWH 2026-11-01). rec.gov photos of 018/019/023/024/025/026 show willows and aspen around the pads and no water. rec.gov's 'several border the lake' supports a view from these sites; a view is not shown in a photo, so if AWH wants photo proof the value would go to 'not waterfront'. Rush Creek (east edge, ~10-15 m wide) is behind the same loop road and willows: no creekside either. Replacement evidence: 'Esri 2026-11-27 + rec.gov catalog: lakeside sites 018-025 20-30 m from the shore with the loop road and a willow belt between; rec.gov "several border the lake" -> lakeview'.

PIN (~300 m): stored 37.78120,-119.12850 is west of Hwy 158 on the Silver Lake Resort / pack-station side. Suggest 37.78332,-119.12632 (centroid of the 63 rec.gov site points; FS point 37.7832,-119.1261).

PHONE: stored 760-924-5500 is the Mammoth Lakes Welcome Center. Suggest 760-934-5795 (rec.gov facility phone and notice 'Please call the office at 760-934-5795'); the FS page's office is the Mono Basin Visitor Center (760) 647-3044.
